verdict.rationale: First-party Entra docs confirm users can sign in with a passkey stored in the Authenticator app, using biometrics or a device PIN for phishing-resistant authentication. That documentation is framed around Microsoft Entra work/school sign-in, though. Nothing shows an everyday user saving passkeys for arbitrary third-party websites and apps; for non-Microsoft accounts the docs describe only codes and approvals. Missing for 10: evidence of passkey storage and sign-in for general consumer websites/apps, passkey setup/management docs for personal users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
